'''[[House Ironvale]]''' believes the only sanctity is improvement. In [[Forge Gap]] no building stands untouched for a generation, the Eternal Forge has never gone out since the Unification — or is quietly relit every night — and every drawing in the Drafting Hall, sooner or later, leaks.
